If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to capture bullish momentum.

If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to offset bearish pressure.

If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and forecast is trending upward, add 0.5–1.0% to mid-horizon (8–15 days) to align with sentiment drift.

If sentiment is neutral and forecast is trending downward, subtract 0.5–1.0% from mid-horizon (8–15 days) to dampen overcorrection.

For late horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is positive, apply +0.3–0.7% to forecast to sustain momentum; if negative, apply -0.3–0.7% to prevent overshoot.

If sentiment shifts from negative to positive within 3 days, apply +1.0–2.0% to forecast at 10-day mark to capture sentiment reversal.
